Cube, The.name: The Cube
Cube, The.summary: Remember those old games from your childhood and feel the taste of passing level after level, absorbing all the soulfulness of our game. Maybe you also want to become a Cube? Based on the British game show of the same name.

FIFA 15 - Legacy Edition.name: FIFA 15: Legacy Edition
FIFA 15 - Legacy Edition.summary: FIFA 15 Legacy Edition on Nintendo 3DS delivers unmatched authenticity that reflects the current football season with updated kits and rosters and over 30 officially licensed leagues, 50 real-world tournaments, 500 authentic clubs and 12,500 players but no updates to gameplay or game modes.

Gaist Crusher.name: Gaist Crusher
Gaist Crusher.summary: Gaist Crusher is an action game set in 2064 when the Gaist Crusher Garrison is set up to defend humans against Gaist, lifeforms completely encrusted in Gaimetal, a metal ore mined by humans since 2047.

Medarot 7 - Kuwagata Ver..name: Medarot 7: Kuwagata Version
Medarot 7 - Kuwagata Ver..summary:
Medarot 7 is the seventh numbered game in the Medarot franchise.

Much like its predecessor Medarot DS, Medarot 7 is an RPG following the adventures of Azuma Amakura and his Medarot Metabee (in the Kabuto version) or Rokusho (in the Kuwagata version). Medarot 7 incorporates many of the gameplay changes made in Medarot DS, but does not function as a sequel. Rather, it completely ignores the events of Medarot DS and begins a new story using the same characters and places.
